lines.text: Reading Roegadyn reporting in. The local voice cache is ready.
Test line complete. I have transformed text into a suspiciously official wave file.
Voice check. If you can hear this, the commentary queue survived another paperwork exercise.
We have moved from {from} to {to}. Mark the map and try not to look impressed.
{to}. New air, new problems, same shoes.
Territory shift confirmed: {from} to {to}. The aetheryte can stop humming now.
Arrived in {to}. I will begin judging the local architecture immediately.
Leaving {from}; entering {to}. This is probably fine.
Welcome back. I have the route notes, the local cache, and a clean mug.
Reading Roegadyn awake. Please direct all complaints to the nearest aetheryte.
You are logged in. I have prepared commentary and lowered expectations.
A rare quiet moment. Even the aetherytes are keeping their opinions to themselves.
Idle check. Nothing is on fire, which is statistically notable.
Still here. Still reading. Still not paid by the syllable.
Combat started. Commentary brief and useful.
Weapon out. I will keep the footnotes short.
Hostilities detected. Try the buttons that make the problem smaller.
Combat ended. I will pretend that was all deliberate.
Threat resolved. The paperwork will say heroic.
All clear. The floor has accepted another donation.
Machinations detected. Someone nearby is about to make paperwork violent.
BGM {bgmId}. That is Machinations. Tighten the straps and distrust the room.
Machinations has entered the ledger. This never means a quiet afternoon.
{job} level {level}. Please update the forms before looking proud.
Level {level} recorded for {job}. The ledger has made a small satisfied noise.
{job} improved to level {level}. Competence remains under review.
Level increase confirmed. {job}, level {level}. The paperwork approves reluctantly.
{job} level {level}. Another number has agreed to be larger.
Advancement logged: {job}, level {level}. Try not to let the form smudge.
{job} reached level {level}. The training budget survived somehow.
Level {level} for {job}. A modest rise in authorized confidence.
{job} level {level}. I will file this under progress, lightly questioned.
{job} selected. New badge, same weather.
Class or job changed to {job}. I will amend the stationery.
{job} is now on duty. The old forms are already sulking.
Equipment identity updated: {job}. Please stand where the role expects.
{job} confirmed. The hotbars are pretending they were ready.
Switched to {job}. A fresh title for familiar consequences.
{job} active. I will adjust the risk column accordingly.
Job change complete: {job}. The ledger loves a new abbreviation.
{job} entered the report. Try to behave like the icon suggests.
Mounted. The walking committee has been adjourned.
Mount secured. Local foot traffic may relax.
Saddle status confirmed. Motion is now outsourced.
You are mounted. I will update the travel estimate and my disappointment.
Mount engaged. The road has lost its argument.
Mounted transport approved. Keep both dignity and inventory attached.
Ride acquired. The route notes are now slightly less bored.
Mounting complete. Walking has been postponed by executive decision.
Mounted. Please refrain from treating stairs as policy suggestions.
Dismounted. The floor has resumed jurisdiction.
Mount dismissed. Your boots are back on payroll.
Transport ended. Walking has filed for reinstatement.
Dismount complete. Please account for all knees.
Back on foot. The route is once again personal.
Mount released. The ground looks smug about it.
Dismounted. I will mark the landing as intentional.
Ride concluded. The travel ledger returns to ordinary stride.
Mount status cleared. Try not to negotiate with the curb.
Flight confirmed. Gravity has filed a complaint.
Airborne. The route has become vertically inconvenient.
Flight started. The ground may wait its turn.
You are flying. Please keep the scenery in the correct order.
Lift achieved. The sky has accepted temporary custody.
Flight engaged. Landmarks are now below their usual station.
Air route approved. Do not make paperwork of the clouds.
Flying now. The map is pretending this was planned.
Flight logged. Try to descend before the report gets ambitious.
Flight ended. Return the sky to its drawer.
Landing confirmed. The ground is being professional about it.
Airborne status cleared. Gravity has closed the ticket.
Flight complete. Please collect your bearings at the exit.
Back on land. The map may resume lying flat.
Landing recorded. No applause required from the terrain.
Flight concluded. The horizon is no longer your problem.
Sky privileges paused. Walking regulations apply again.
Descent complete. I will file it under acceptable vertical conduct.
Duty queue joined. Waiting has acquired an official title.
Queued for duty. The roulette desk has opened a file.
Duty registration active. Please enjoy uncertainty in an orderly fashion.
Queue entered. The finder will now consider your fate.
Duty queue confirmed. Time to practice patient optimism.
Registration submitted. Somewhere, a matching algorithm is sighing.
Queue status active. The clipboard has taken your name.
Duty request filed. Results may contain strangers.
Queued. Prepare for a pop-up with opinions.
Duty queue ended. The clipboard may unclench.
Queue status cleared. Waiting has left the premises.
Duty registration closed. The finder has stopped staring.
Queue removed. Your schedule is pretending to be flexible.
Duty queue cleared. The paperwork returns to standby.
Registration ended. The matching desk has put down its pen.
Queue no longer active. That silence is probably meaningful.
Duty request withdrawn or resolved. Either way, fewer forms.
Queue finished. The wait has been archived under maybe.
Duty commenced. Please keep heroics within posted guidelines.
Duty started. The room expects competence and accepts substitutes.
Bound by duty. The exit has become theoretical.
Instance obligations active. Try not to confuse urgency with planning.
Duty engagement recorded. The objective has entered the ledger.
You are on duty. The report has sharpened its pencil.
Duty boundary crossed. Local consequences are now official.
Operation started. Please sort danger by priority and height.
Duty active. I will assume the ready check was legally binding.
Duty concluded. Everyone pretend the report was tidy.
Duty ended. The instance has released its grip.
Objective complete or abandoned. The form is not picky.
Bound by duty cleared. The exit exists again.
Duty record closed. Please collect loot and composure.
Instance obligations ended. The ledger has enough bruises.
Duty finished. I will omit several tactical adjectives.
Operation closed. The paperwork will be kinder than memory.
Duty complete. Return borrowed courage to storage.
Crafting started. The desk has requested incident coverage.
Synthesis begun. Materials are now suspects.
Crafting action active. Please respect the durability column.
Recipe engaged. The workshop has entered negotiation.
Crafting underway. Tools are being asked to justify themselves.
Synthesis logged. Quality is making demands again.
Crafting state confirmed. The materials look nervous.
Production started. Try to keep inspiration within budget.
Crafting file opened. The result will claim it was intentional.
Crafting ended. No one mention the offcuts.
Synthesis closed. The bench may exhale.
Crafting complete. Quality has stopped arguing for now.
Production ended. The tools are returning to plausible innocence.
Recipe resolved. File the result under deliberate.
Crafting state cleared. The material ledger is lighter.
Synthesis finished. I will not ask about the spare pieces.
Workshop quiet. The item exists, which is legally sufficient.
Crafting complete. Please dust the evidence from the counter.
Gathering started. The dirt is now a stakeholder.
Gathering action active. The land has been notified.
Resource extraction begun. Nature has declined to comment.
Gathering underway. Please interrogate the node politely.
Field work started. The inventory is clearing its throat.
Gathering registered. Rocks and shrubs should prepare statements.
Node work active. The survey notes are watching.
Harvesting begun. The land is pretending this is fine.
Gathering file opened. Expect dirt and partial truths.
Gathering ended. The land has been inconvenienced.
Field work complete. The node may return to being suspicious.
Gathering state cleared. Inventory weight has new opinions.
Resource extraction ended. The survey file looks smug.
Harvesting complete. Please brush the evidence from your gloves.
Gathering concluded. Nature will recover after several forms.
Node work ended. The map can stop pretending it helped.
Field notes closed. The result is probably useful.
Gathering complete. The ground requests a brief recess.
Fishing started. We will negotiate with water.
Line cast. Patience has entered the job description.
Fishing state active. The water is being evasive.
Angling begun. Please keep hope at a manageable volume.
Fishing logged. The bait has accepted its brief career.
Line out. The report now includes waiting near water.
Fishing engaged. The catch table is already being difficult.
Waterfront operations started. Results may be damp and judgmental.
Casting complete. Now we perform the ancient art of staring.
Fishing ended. The fish have submitted mixed feedback.
Line recovered. Patience may clock out.
Fishing state cleared. The water keeps its secrets.
Angling concluded. The bait ledger is closed.
Fishing complete. Inventory may or may not smell official.
Waterfront operations ended. The report is mostly damp.
Rod stowed. Hope returns to normal administrative levels.
Fishing filed. The catch table has stopped glaring.
Line in. The water has been excused from further testimony.
Cutscene started. I will hold your place in reality.
Narrative lock engaged. Buttons may wait outside.
Cutscene active. The script has seized the room.
Story event started. Please admire the dramatic paperwork.
Scene in progress. Agency has stepped out briefly.
Cutscene confirmed. The camera has opinions now.
Narrative custody accepted. I will pause the practical remarks.
Scene opened. The report will use smaller margins.
Cutscene underway. Please keep snacks away from revelations.
Cutscene ended. Reality has resumed billing.
Narrative lock cleared. Buttons are legally back.
Scene complete. The camera has returned your agency.
Story event ended. Please process feelings in a single file.
Cutscene closed. The practical problems have waited outside.
Narrative custody released. The ledger needs a moment.
Scene ended. Dramatic pauses may now disperse.
Cutscene complete. The next task is pretending we are composed.
Story resumed normal controls. I will reopen the consequence file.
Performance started. The arts have entered the ledger.
Instrument engaged. Noise is now culturally protected.
Performance mode active. The audience may form a line.
Music begun. The report will avoid judging rhythm.
Performance registered. Please tune ambition before volume.
Artistic activity confirmed. I will prepare diplomatic applause.
Instrument file opened. Nearby ears have been notified.
Performance underway. Tempo is now a compliance matter.
Music state active. The ledger is tapping one finger.
Performance ended. Applause may be filed alphabetically.
Instrument dismissed. The air is recovering.
Performance mode cleared. Rhythm has left the report.
Music concluded. The ledger will call it expressive.
Artistic activity ended. Please collect any remaining dignity.
Performance closed. Nearby ears may return to duty.
Instrument file archived. The final note has been detained.
Music state cleared. The silence is acting important.
Performance complete. I will not grade the bridge.
Mini-game started. Small stakes, full paperwork.
Side activity engaged. The ledger accepts tiny risks.
Mini-game active. Serious faces are optional but common.
Game table opened. Probability has asked for a chair.
Diversion started. Productivity has been placed on hold.
Mini-game registered. The score column is clearing its throat.
Side contest underway. The rules are wearing a small hat.
Game state active. Please misplace time responsibly.
Mini-game file opened. Victory may be narrower than advertised.
Mini-game ended. The ledger accepts tiny victories.
Side activity closed. Productivity has been notified.
Mini-game cleared. The score can stop making eye contact.
Game table closed. Probability has left crumbs.
Diversion complete. Time was spent, not necessarily invested.
Mini-game filed. The result is official enough.
Side contest ended. Please restore your serious face.
Game state cleared. The rules have stopped explaining themselves.
Mini-game complete. I will archive the tiny drama.
Summoning bell engaged. Retainers, brace for questions.
Bell access started. Commerce has entered the room.
Summoning bell active. Inventory management is now personal.
Retainer desk opened. Please keep financial surprises labeled.
Bell interaction logged. Someone is about to move many small things.
Retainer interface active. The market board is pretending innocence.
Summoning bell in use. Storage will be asked difficult questions.
Bell file opened. The gil column is sitting upright.
Retainers contacted. Please do not call this a quick errand.
Summoning bell released. Commerce may breathe again.
Bell access ended. Retainers may resume pretending to be busy.
Summoning bell cleared. Inventory has new emotional weight.
Retainer desk closed. The market board has hidden the evidence.
Bell interaction complete. Storage survived another audit.
Retainer interface closed. The gil column looks different.
Summoning bell done. Please count your items before blaming fate.
Bell file archived. The errand was not quick, noted.
Retainers dismissed. Commerce returns to background suspicion.
Party Finder opened. Strangers will now self-categorize.
Recruitment interface active. Expectations are being sorted by color.
Party Finder engaged. Social risk is now searchable.
Listings opened. Please read the fine print and the mood.
Party Finder active. The abbreviations have begun gathering.
Recruitment board opened. Optimism has posted a listing.
Party search started. Requirements may be decorative.
Listing review underway. The duty may not be the hard part.
Party Finder file opened. Compatibility is filling out a form.
Party Finder closed. The social ledger is temporarily quiet.
Recruitment interface cleared. Expectations remain unresolved.
Party Finder ended. Strangers return to being theoretical.
Listings closed. The fine print has stopped whispering.
Party search complete. The abbreviations have dispersed.
Recruitment board closed. Optimism has left no forwarding address.
Party Finder filed. Social risk returns to ambient levels.
Listing review ended. Compatibility has deferred judgment.
Party Finder quiet. The board is resting between opinions.
Swimming started. Boots are no longer policy-compliant.
Water entry confirmed. Dryness has been postponed.
Swimming active. Inventory has questions about waterproofing.
Aquatic movement logged. The map did not warn us enough.
You are swimming. Please keep paperwork above the splash line.
Water travel engaged. Socks have entered a grievance.
Swimming state active. The shore is suddenly administrative.
Buoyancy accepted. The route has become damp.
Water crossing started. I will mark dignity as optional.
Swimming ended. Drip responsibly.
Water exit confirmed. Dryness may begin negotiations.
Swimming cleared. Inventory can stop worrying so loudly.
Aquatic movement ended. The map resumes ordinary lying.
Back on shore. Please wring out any remaining plans.
Water travel closed. Socks have escalated the complaint.
Swimming state ended. The shore has accepted your return.
Buoyancy released. The route is less damp on paper.
Water crossing complete. Dignity status remains pending.
Diving started. The ocean has accepted your application.
Submerged. Breathing is now an agenda item.
Diving active. The surface has been placed above us.
Underwater travel logged. Visibility is filing a complaint.
Dive confirmed. Please keep discoveries in alphabetical order.
Descent underway. The water pressure has opinions.
Diving state active. The map has become suspiciously blue.
Subsurface route opened. Try not to misplace the up direction.
Underwater operations started. Silence is now compulsory.
Diving ended. Surface paperwork restored.
Resurfaced. Breathing has returned to routine status.
Diving cleared. The surface is back where policy expects.
Underwater travel ended. Visibility may stop complaining.
Dive complete. Please file any discoveries before they dry.
Ascent recorded. The pressure column is relieved.
Diving state ended. The map is less blue about it.
Subsurface route closed. Up direction successfully recovered.
Underwater operations complete. Silence has been dismissed.
Unconscious. I will mark this as a training expense.

Unconscious status confirmed. Heroics have entered review.
Movement privileges suspended. Please await corrective paperwork.
Downed. The report will be careful with the word tactical.
Unconscious logged. The floor is being very possessive.
Status: not upright. I will notify the confidence department.
You have stopped contributing vertically. Noted with concern.
Unconscious state active. The ledger suggests assistance.
Recovered. The floor has released its claim.
Back up. Please return dignity to an upright position.
Unconscious status cleared. Heroics may resume under supervision.
Movement privileges restored. The paperwork remains skeptical.
Recovery logged. The report will call it resilience.
Standing again. The floor looks disappointed but professional.
Status: upright. Confidence may reapply in writing.
Recovered from downed state. Try not to make it a pattern.
Consciousness restored. The ledger has reopened your tab.
